sources.title: Aegis AI
sources.snippet: How is AEGIS different from traditional AI camera safety systems? Traditional systems detect objects and send alerts. AEGIS understands risk. Instead of reacting to a single frame, it evaluates context over time—including zones, movement, proximity, and activity state—so interventions happen only when there is real safety risk.

sources.title: AegisAI | The Agentic AI Email Security Platform
sources.snippet: Aegis AI is a next generation agentic email security platform. It uses AI agents to analyze every email like a human analyst — detecting phishing, Business Email Compromise (BEC), and zero-day threats that bypass traditional rule-based filters.
